files_the_adapter_reads.what: the meaning of the `resolves to always-blocked address` reason (PR 3740)

declared_controls.control: outbound endpoints on loopback, link-local or unspecified addresses (incl. 169.254.169.254)
declared_controls.detail: v0.1.1: these addresses 'are always blocked'. v0.1.2: 'Network policy never authorizes an outbound endpoint whose destination is loopback, link-local, or unspecified ... This restriction does not apply to sandbox-local loopback connections'. The rego is byte-identical, so this documents behaviour that v0.1.1 already had.
declared_controls.adapter_change: adapter 0.2.0: a witnessed loopback attempt with no enforcer record is UNMODELLED (code LOOPBACK_OFF_POLICY_PATH), not DIVERGED; with an enforcer record it is still compared. Link-local and unspecified are unchanged (always DENIED on the policy path).

declared_controls.detail: PR 3745: workload bytes that followed the synthesized CONNECT header in the proxy's first read could be dropped. A witness on v0.1.1 could therefore see a permitted request fail; on v0.1.2 it should not.
declared_controls.adapter_change: none; runs must state --enforcer-version, and OVERBLOCK rows on v0.1.1 captures should be read with this fix in mind

declared_controls.detail: PR 3757: the reaper wakes on child exit instead of scanning procfs. No policy field is involved.

declared_controls.control: network_policies rules, deny precedence, enforcement audit/enforce, L7 REST matching, control-plane ports, filesystem_policy, landlock, process, seccomp baseline
declared_controls.detail: rego and the schema text for these fields are unchanged apart from the loopback paragraph
crates identical; schema_version 1; exit codes 0/1/2/3/130 as documented

items: #3335 MCP request inspection with protocol profiles; rego adds mcp_method_classification (extension methods need an exact allow)
#3753 JSON-RPC and MCP endpoints refuse Upgrade requests with 403
